"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents stripped to their base letter, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
EOF

"""Text truncation for previews."""

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters (including "..."), cutting at the last whole word that fits."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - len(ELLIPSIS)
    if budget <= 0:
        return ELLIPSIS[:limit]
    # Largest cut point <= budget that falls on whitespace (i.e. between words).
    window = text[: budget + 1]
    idx = len(window.rstrip()) if False else max(window.rfind(c) for c in " \t\n\r\f\v")
    cut = window[:idx].rstrip() if idx > 0 else ""
    if not cut:
        # No whole word fits; avoid splitting a word.
        return ELLIPSIS
    return cut + ELLIPSIS
EOF

        return ELLIPSIS[:limit]
    # Characters text[:budget+1] may be kept; the cut must land on whitespace
    # so that no word is split.
    window = text[: budget + 1]
    idx = max(window.rfind(c) for c in " \t\n\r\f\v")
    cut = window[:idx].rstrip() if idx > 0 else ""
    if not cut:
        # No whole word fits within the limit.
        return ELLIPSIS
    return cut + ELLIPSIS
